## E0046: an impl must define an item whose trait default body is unstable

`impl Drop for S {}` reports nothing in blaze. rustc reports E0046 ("not all trait items implemented, missing: `drop`"). In the pinned nightly, `Drop::drop` has a default body (it calls `pin_drop`) under `#[rustc_default_body_unstable(feature = "pin_ergonomics", issue = "130494")]` (library/core/src/ops/drop.rs:241-243). rustc's `check_impl_items_against_trait` counts an item as missing when the impl's crate lacks the default body's feature (`eval_default_body_stability`, then `default_body_is_unstable`). blaze's missing-items check (crates/hir/src/diagnostics.rs:2307-2311) only asks `has_body()`, so the default body hides the missing `drop`. Every `impl Drop` without `drop` in real code goes unreported. Fix: port the rule. An item whose default body is `rustc_default_body_unstable` under a feature the impl crate doesn't enable is required, and the report notes that the default is unstable. blaze-diagnostics already parses the attribute (checks/attrs/parsers/stability.rs:164, checks/features/library.rs:480). Test: blaze-diagnostics tests::items::impls::a_missing_drop_method. Its minicore fixture also needs the attribute (a coordinator request from fix-diag-lints).
